ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) surface area with high-intensity (white/yellowish) pixels localized to less than 5% of the visible fluke area at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base pigmentation is a uniform dark grey field. High-contrast white/yellowish contiguous pixel blobs are mapped to the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Subtle dark mottling is present on the ventral surface of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 76 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys observed along the continuous boundary of the trailing edge from the notch to both tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading/outer edges tapering to acute points; the trailing edge maintains a roughly horizontal orientation with slight concave transitions near the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, roughly circular clusters of high-intensity white/yellow pixels concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, sub-parallel dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant scarring and irregular surface texture at both fluke tips, characterized by high-contrast pigmentation and edge erosion.
